name: Righteous Smash
description: Your next melee swing strikes the target for weapon damage plus a bonus. Every hit grants a stack of Conviction.
assumptions: Bonus 22 + 2/level and a 12 rage cost (Davis 2026-10-25, a small Vanguard damage buff; was 14.3 + 2/level for 15 rage, Heroic Strike 9.5 + 1.4 L about 30% better). The five-Calling sim at Power Level 10 in greens read 23.7 DPS before and 26.4 after, still under the Initiate's 29.9 and the Cutthroat's 40.3. A landed hit adds 1 stack of Conviction; a miss, dodge or parry adds none. Vengeful Conviction's 2-stack empowerment waits on the on-block trigger.

name: Bulwark Charge
description: Charge an enemy, generating 15 Rage and leaving Consecration at the destination: for 8 sec, each second every enemy within 8 yd takes Holy damage. You take 10% less damage while you stand in it. Usable in combat.
assumptions: 8-25 yd, 15 s cooldown, usable in combat (Davis 2026-10-17). Consecration placeholders (#103): radius 8 yd, a tick every 1 s for 8 s, 4 + 0.6/level Holy a tick, one patch per caster (a new one replaces the old). Centred where the charge ends. A tick cannot miss or crit and ignores armour. The caster standing in their own patch wears aura_consecration_ward, 10% less damage taken from every school (#509, Vanguard grill 2026-10-29); another player inside gets nothing. Inside is the flat distance to the patch's centre within its radius, checked every tick.

name: Consecration
description: The holy ground Bulwark Charge leaves at its destination.
notes: The patch Bulwark Charge's ground_effect names (ground_spell=consecration): its DynamicObject and its tick logs carry this row's spell id (#318, ADR 0017). Off the spell book; never cast by itself.

assumptions: Cutthroat grill 2026-10-29 (#505). drop_chance=100: the bleed's own droplet chance replaces the Calling's 50%.

name: Sanguine Rupture
description: Finishing move: a bleed that deals damage every 2 sec for 6 sec, plus 2 sec and more damage per combo point. You heal for 80% of the damage it deals. Each tick may spill a blood droplet nearby.
assumptions: Cutthroat grill 2026-10-29 (#505). leech_pct=80 instead of 40.

name: Blood Frenzy
description: Bloodlust stacks up to 10 times instead of 5.
assumptions: Cutthroat grill 2026-10-29 (#505). The old tree's Blood Frenzy at one rank: aura_max_stacks 5 more on aura_bloodlust.

name: Thirst
description: Each blood droplet you pick up heals you for 10% of your maximum health.
assumptions: Cutthroat grill 2026-10-29 (#505). The old tree's Thirst at one rank: pickup_heal_pct 10.

name: Blood Rush
description: Each blood droplet you pick up gives you 10 Energy.
assumptions: Cutthroat grill 2026-10-29 (#505). pickup_energize 10: each droplet picked up gives 10 of the character's own power.

name: Brazen Garrote
description: Garrote the enemy, causing it to bleed every 3 sec for 18 sec. Awards 1 combo point. Each tick may spill a blood droplet nearby. Needs no Stealth.
assumptions: Cutthroat grill 2026-10-29 (#505). requires=- drops Garrote's stealth=yes; the client row has no stealth gate. No cooldown, as plain Garrote has none; a recast refreshes the bleed. From Stealth it still opens with a critical strike.

name: Choking Garrote
description: From Stealth: garrote the enemy, causing it to bleed every 3 sec for 18 sec. Stuns the target for 3 sec. Awards 1 combo point. Each tick may spill a blood droplet nearby.
assumptions: Cutthroat grill 2026-10-29 (#505). A 3 s stun under Cheap Shot's stock aura id 1833, the inline form of Hammer of Justice; it takes diminishing returns as Bull Rush's stun does.

name: Initiative
description: From Stealth: garrote the enemy, causing it to bleed every 3 sec for 18 sec. Awards 3 combo points. Each tick may spill a blood droplet nearby.
assumptions: Cutthroat grill 2026-10-29 (#505). add_combo_points 3 instead of 1.

name: Evasion
description: Dodge chance increased by 50%. Each dodge gives 10 Energy and 1 combo point.
assumptions: Cutthroat grill 2026-10-29 (#505). Phantom Guile's buff: aura_evasion with a dodge proc for 10 Energy and 1 combo point on the mob the Cutthroat is attacking.

name: Initiate
description: A volatile apprentice who manipulates raw mana and weaves basic elemental forces to devastate their enemies.
assumptions: Tier 1, Tier Cap 30, form 0, mana, like Cutthroat (Davis 2026-10-18).

name: Ley-Spark
description: Your primary casted filler. Deals Arcane damage. Its critical strike chance naturally scales higher based on how full your current mana pool is.
assumptions: Borrowed Starfire r1 (2912), not Arcane Missiles: the patch cannot clear the channel flag (Davis 2026-10-18). 31 + 2.5/level: Arcane Missiles r1 (26 a second) over the 1.5 s cast, about 30% better, at level 8. No weapon needed (the sheet said any_melee|wand). Crit +15 points at full mana, scaled by fill after the cost (placeholder).

name: Searing Ember
description: Instant cast. Deals low initial Fire damage and leaves a stacking burn DoT on the target.
assumptions: Fireball r1 (14-22) about 30% better, instant (Davis 2026-10-18).

name: Searing Ember
description: Burning for Fire damage every 3 sec.
assumptions: Fireball r1's burn (2 over 4 s) at the same rate over 12 s in 3 s ticks, about 30% better (Davis 2026-10-18). Each new stack restarts the tick timer (placeholder).

name: Biting Cold
description: Deals moderate Frost damage and heavily slows the target's movement speed for 6 seconds.
assumptions: Frostbolt r1 (18-20) about 30% better, 2.5 s cast (Davis 2026-10-18); 2 s cast, 15 + 1.5 per level, 6 s slow (#294).

name: Biting Cold
description: Movement speed slowed by 50%.
assumptions: 50% for 5 s (Davis 2026-10-18). Two snares on one mob, the strongest wins; the speed changes on the server only.

name: Catalyst
description: The detonator. Consumes your Searing Embers and Biting Colds on the target. If it consumes an Ember, it instantly refunds 10% of your maximum Mana. If it consumes a Cold, it deals a massive burst of shatter damage.
assumptions: Borrowed Moonfire r1 (8921), an instant enemy-targeted arcane row, not Arcane Explosion (Davis 2026-10-18). Shatter: 2x Biting Cold's hit; Ember: a 10% max-mana refund (#294). A consumed Ember counts once however many stacks it holds. The shatter is in Biting Cold's school (Frost) and crits on the caster's chance plus Catalyst's own (#122).

name: Blink
description: Teleports you forward 20 yards and frees you from stuns and roots.
assumptions: Usable while stunned; it sheds stuns and roots before the move. It steps 1 yd at a time over the ground and stops short where there is none or the ground rises or falls more than 1.5 yd in a step (placeholder).

name: Ley Ward
description: Surrounds you with a ward of ley energy that absorbs damage equal to 10% of your maximum mana for 20 sec.
assumptions: Initiate balance (#294): a once-a-fight shield, 10% of maximum mana. Shape copied from Blink; its GCD cells are Blink's (empty). Borrowed Mana Shield visual 1463.

name: Thermal Feedback
description: Your next Biting Cold is instant and costs no mana.
assumptions: Borrowed spell 11069 (the talent's rank 1) for the icon. Lasts 15 s (placeholder).

name: Arcane Substrate
description: Your next Biting Cold casts 0.5 sec faster.
assumptions: Borrowed spell 12536 (Clearcasting) for the icon (#119). Lasts 15 s (placeholder); granted with the Ember rider, each goes with its own skill's next cast (#506).

name: Arcane Substrate
description: Your next Searing Ember burns 5 sec longer.
assumptions: Borrowed spell 11129 (Combustion) for the icon (#119). Lasts 15 s (placeholder); granted with the Cold rider, each goes with its own skill's next cast (#506).

name: Shattered Blink
description: Frozen in place.
assumptions: Borrowed spell 122 (Frost Nova) for the icon (#118). The mob still attacks and casts; damage does not break it.

name: Arcane Momentum
description: Ley-Spark deals 45% more damage.
assumptions: Borrowed spell 15060 (the talent's rank 3) for the icon (#120). A new Blink starts it over.

name: Catalytic Resonance
description: Spell damage increased by 10%.
assumptions: Borrowed spell 12042 (Arcane Power) for the icon (#117). Raises non-physical skill damage; a new one replaces the old.

name: Ley-Line Tap
description: Your primary casted filler. Deals Arcane damage. Its critical strike chance naturally scales higher based on how full your current mana pool is. Each cast has a 50% chance to refund its mana cost. At full mana, it shields you for twice its cost for 10 sec instead.
assumptions: Initiate grill 2026-10-29 (#506). The old talent at its full rank. refund_cost rolls 50% once as the cast lands: below a full bar the whole cost comes back; at a bar that was full before the cast, a 10 s shield of 200% of the cost goes up and nothing comes back.

name: Arcane Substrate
description: Your primary casted filler. Deals Arcane damage. Its critical strike chance naturally scales higher based on how full your current mana pool is. Each cast also makes your next Biting Cold cast 0.5 sec faster and your next Searing Ember burn 5 sec longer.
assumptions: Initiate grill 2026-10-29 (#506). The old talent at its full rank. Each cast grants both riders, aura_arcane_substrate_cold_5 and aura_arcane_substrate_ember_5; each goes with its own skill's next cast and leaves the other.

name: Warding Spark
description: Your primary casted filler. Deals Arcane damage. Its critical strike chance naturally scales higher based on how full your current mana pool is. A critical hit also wards you for 50% of its damage for 8 sec.
assumptions: Initiate grill 2026-10-29 (#506). absorb pct=50 of the hit, only on a critical strike (if_crit). A new ward replaces the old one only when it is larger.

name: Siphoning Ward
description: Surrounds you with a ward of ley energy that absorbs damage equal to 10% of your maximum mana for 20 sec. Half of the damage it absorbs comes back to you as mana.
assumptions: Initiate grill 2026-10-29 (#506). absorb energize_pct=50: each soak gives half the soaked amount as mana, rounded down.

name: Frost Ward
description: Surrounds you with a ward of ley energy that absorbs damage equal to 10% of your maximum mana for 20 sec. An enemy whose damage it absorbs is slowed by 50% for 4 sec.
assumptions: Initiate grill 2026-10-29 (#506). absorb attacker_aura=aura_frost_ward: each soak of an enemy's blow, spell or tick puts the aura on that enemy. Its own aura, so Catalyst does not shatter it, but a snare, so Frostbite sees it.

name: Volatile Ward
description: Surrounds you with a ward of ley energy that absorbs damage equal to 10% of your maximum mana for 20 sec. When the ward breaks, it bursts for the damage it absorbed as Arcane damage to enemies within 8 yards.
assumptions: Initiate grill 2026-10-29 (#506). absorb burst_radius_yd=8: when the whole ward is soaked, every living enemy within 8 yd of the Initiate takes its amount as Arcane damage, with Arcane's miss and crit rolls. A ward that times out or is replaced does nothing.

name: Thermal Feedback
description: Instant cast. Deals low initial Fire damage and leaves a stacking burn DoT on the target. Each tick of the burn has a 10% chance to make your next Biting Cold instant and free.
assumptions: Initiate grill 2026-10-29 (#506). Davis chose 10% (the old talent had 20%). periodic_damage tick_aura=aura_thermal_feedback, tick_aura_chance=10: rolled once per tick, whatever the stacks. The burn keeps aura_searing_ember's spell id.

name: Smoldering Ember
description: Instant cast. Deals low initial Fire damage and leaves a stacking burn DoT on the target. A burning enemy deals 15% less damage to you.
assumptions: Initiate grill 2026-10-29 (#506). periodic_damage weaken_pct=15: while the burn is on a unit, its swings, spells and ticks at the Initiate deal 15% less. Other players take the full amount.

name: Kindling Ember
description: Instant cast. Deals low initial Fire damage and leaves a stacking burn DoT on the target. Each tick of the burn returns 3% of your maximum mana.
assumptions: Initiate grill 2026-10-29 (#506). Davis chose 3%. periodic_damage tick_energize_pct_of_max=3: once per tick, whatever the stacks.

name: Combustion Engine
description: Deals moderate Frost damage and heavily slows the target's movement speed for 6 seconds. Deals 45% more damage to a target burning from your Searing Ember.
assumptions: Initiate grill 2026-10-29 (#506). The old talent at its full rank. school_damage vs_aura=aura_searing_ember, vs_aura_pct=45, read as the blow lands.

name: Splintering Cold
description: Deals moderate Frost damage and heavily slows the target's movement speed for 6 seconds. The slow also lands on every enemy within 8 yards of the target.
assumptions: Initiate grill 2026-10-29 (#506). mod_run_speed radius_yd=8: Biting Cold's own aura, without the hit, on every other living enemy within 8 yd of the target, so Catalyst shatters it on any of them.

name: Frostbite
description: Deals moderate Frost damage and heavily slows the target's movement speed for 6 seconds. A target that was already slowed is also rooted for 2 sec.
assumptions: Initiate grill 2026-10-29 (#506). Davis chose the condition. root under the stock Frostbite aura 12494 for 2 s, only on a target that wore any snare before the cast landed (requires_target_aura=slowed): this cast's own slow does not count. Roots take no diminishing returns in the realm.

name: Shattered Blink
description: Blinking leaves behind a ring of frost at your starting location, rooting all enemies within 8 yards for 4 seconds.
assumptions: Initiate grill 2026-10-29 (#506). The old talent at its full rank (2): a proc on Blink's cast putting aura_shattered_blink_2 on every enemy within 8 yd of where the Initiate stood.

name: Arcane Momentum
description: After using Blink, the damage of your Ley-Spark is increased by 45% for 5 seconds.
assumptions: Initiate grill 2026-10-29 (#506). The old talent at its full rank (3): a proc on Blink's cast granting aura_arcane_momentum_3.

name: Catalytic Resonance
description: Whenever Catalyst consumes a Searing Ember or a Biting Cold, you gain 10% increased spell damage for 8 seconds.
assumptions: Initiate grill 2026-10-29 (#506). The old talent at its full rank (5): a proc on each consume of Catalyst or its Skill Choice granting aura_catalytic_resonance_5. The icon is its own buff's; the old one was Catalyst's.

name: Thermal Shock
description: The detonator. Consumes your Searing Embers and Biting Colds on the target. If it consumes an Ember, it instantly refunds 13% of your maximum Mana. If it consumes a Cold, it deals a massive burst of shatter damage. The shatter deals 30% more than Catalyst's.
assumptions: Initiate grill 2026-10-29 (#506). The old talent at its full rank: 30% more on both consumes, the shatter 260% of Biting Cold's hit instead of 200% and the refund 13% of maximum mana instead of 10%.

name: Deep Freeze
description: The detonator. Consumes your Searing Embers and Biting Colds on the target. If it consumes an Ember, it instantly refunds 10% of your maximum Mana. If it consumes a Cold, it deals a massive burst of shatter damage. Consuming a Biting Cold also stuns the target for 3 sec.
assumptions: Initiate grill 2026-10-29 (#506). stun under the stock Impact aura 12355 for 3 s, only on a target that wore Biting Cold before the cast landed (requires_target_aura=aura_biting_cold), so effect 1 consuming it does not hide it. It takes diminishing returns as Bull Rush's stun does.

name: Catalytic Chain
description: The detonator. Consumes your Searing Embers and Biting Colds on the target. If it consumes an Ember, it instantly refunds 10% of your maximum Mana. If it consumes a Cold, it deals a massive burst of shatter damage. Each Ember or Cold it consumes is copied onto another enemy within 10 yards.
assumptions: Initiate grill 2026-10-29 (#506). The old talent at its full rank. consume_aura spread_yd=10 on both consumes: a fresh copy, one stack and the row's full duration, on the nearest other living enemy within 10 yd of the target; nothing spreads when nothing was consumed.

name: Frost Ward
description: Movement speed slowed by 50%.
assumptions: Initiate grill 2026-10-29 (#506). Frost Ward's slow: aura_biting_cold's row under its own spell id, for 4 s. Not Biting Cold's aura, so Catalyst does not shatter it; a snare, so Frostbite sees it.

name: Ranger
description: A rugged, tactical marksman who controls the engagement distance. The Ranger balances high-mobility, rapid-fire archery while on the move with heavy, armor-shattering artillery shots when they plant their feet.
assumptions: Tier 1, Tier Cap 30, form 0, mana, leather and mail as the sheet has it (Davis 2026-10-18).

name: Auto Shot
description: Automatically shoots the target with your ranged weapon until cancelled.
assumptions: Vanilla Auto Shot (75), known by every Ranger (#124). A white shot at the ranged weapon's speed, ranged attack power = agility 1:1, no ammo used. Shares no cooldown with the shots, and a shot does not reset its timer.

name: Snapshot
description: Instant cast. Low mana cost. Your primary mobile filler. Fires a quick physical arrow at the target.
assumptions: Borrowed Arcane Shot r1 (3044), patched physical and off its 6 s cooldown. Bonus: Arcane Shot r1 (+13) about 30% better (Davis 2026-10-18). Rolls the ranged weapon; 8 yd minimum range (#124). Balance pass (#295): costs 5% of base mana.

name: Puncturing Shaft
description: Your heavy artillery. Deals massive physical damage and naturally ignores a flat amount of the target's armor.
assumptions: Borrowed Aimed Shot r1 (19434), 3 s cast. Bonus: Aimed Shot r1 (+70 at level 20) about 30% better (Davis 2026-10-18). Ignores 100 + 10/level of the target's armour (placeholder, #126). Rolls the ranged weapon; 8 yd minimum range (#124). Balance pass (#295): bonus raised to +45 plus 5 per level, since Auto Shot holds while the cast bar runs.

name: Barbed Arrow
description: Sinks a jagged arrow into the target, dealing physical damage over time and slowing their movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds.
assumptions: Borrowed Serpent Sting r1 (1978), patched physical, 8 s. 8 yd minimum range, the 30% snare on its aura (#124).

name: Barbed Arrow
description: Physical damage over time. Movement speed slowed by 30%.
assumptions: Serpent Sting r1 (20 over 15 s) about 30% better, over 8 s in 2 s ticks (Davis 2026-10-18). The 30% snare rides the same aura (#124). Balance pass (#295): tick raised to 6 plus 0.5 per level.

name: Vault
description: You instantly leap backward 15 yards to escape melee range and maintain your firing distance.
assumptions: Borrowed Disengage r1 (781). A 15 yd leap straight back from the facing over the ground, on Blink's path (#118, #125); it keeps the facing and, as Blink does, sheds stuns and roots.

name: Rapid Fire
description: For 10 seconds, your ranged attack speed is increased by 40%, and your auto-shots refund a small amount of mana on hit.
assumptions: Borrowed Rapid Fire (3045). 40% ranged haste for 10 s, and 1% of base mana back for each Auto Shot that hits (placeholder for the sheet's 'a small amount', #126).

name: Field Dressing
description: Binds your wounds, healing 20% of your maximum health over 10 sec.
assumptions: Balance pass (#295): a self heal for the Ranger, five ticks of 4% of maximum health, usable in combat. Shaped from Rapid Fire; First Aid visual 746.

name: Rapid Fire
description: Ranged attack speed increased by 40%. Auto-shots refund mana.
assumptions: Ranged haste 40%; each Auto Shot that deals damage gives 1% of base mana (#126).

name: Guerilla Tactics
description: Your next Snapshot deals 50% more damage per stack.
assumptions: Put on by 2 s of moving (#125), stacking to 3; the next Snapshot uses it all. 15 s (placeholder). Borrowed the talent's rank 5 spell for the icon.

name: Rhythmic Draw
description: Your next Puncturing Shaft casts 0.5 sec faster per stack.
assumptions: Put on by each Snapshot (#127), stacking to 15; the next Shaft uses it all, never below an instant cast. 15 s (placeholder). Borrowed the talent's rank 5 spell for the icon.

name: Flurry
description: Your next 2 Snapshots cost no mana and are critical strikes.
assumptions: Put on by Rapid Fire (#127), 2 charges. 15 s (placeholder). Borrowed the talent's rank 2 spell for the icon.

name: Rapid Assault
description: Each Snapshot fires an extra arrow for 50% weapon damage.
assumptions: 8 s (#127). Borrowed the talent's spell for the icon.

name: Sundered
description: Armor reduced by 250 per stack.
assumptions: Put on by Barbed Arrow's ticks (#127), stacking to 3. Borrowed the talent's rank 5 spell for the icon.

name: Explosive Payload
description: Your next Auto Shot explodes, dealing 150% weapon damage as Fire to the target and all enemies within 8 yards.
assumptions: 15 s to use it (placeholder). Borrowed the talent's spell for the icon (#126).

name: Explosive Shot
description: 150% weapon damage as Fire to the target and all enemies within 8 yards.
assumptions: Explosive Payload's shot, cast in place of the next Auto Shot (#126). Borrows Explosive Trap Effect (13812), a Fire hunter spell, so its SpellGo and damage log name a real row (#154); spellbook=no keeps it off the spell book and the trainer.

name: Explosive Payload
description: 15-second cooldown. Instantly replaces your next auto-shot with a volatile explosive shell. On impact, it deals 150% weapon damage as Fire damage to the primary target and all enemies within 8 yards.
assumptions: Ranger grill 2026-10-29 (#507). The old active talent's cast cells: a self buff (aura_explosive_payload) that turns the next Auto Shot into the hidden Explosive Shot. Its INV_Misc_Bomb_04 icon replaces the old one, which was Silencing Shot's, and goes on the buff too.

name: Guerilla Tactics
description: Moving continuously for 2 seconds grants a stacking buff that increases the damage of your next Snapshot by 50%. Stacks up to 3 times.
assumptions: Ranger grill 2026-10-29 (#507). The old talent at its full rank (5): each 2 s of moving without stopping puts a stack of aura_guerilla_tactics_5 up, 3 at most; the next Snapshot, or a Snapshot Skill Choice, spends them.

name: Point Blank
description: Removes the minimum range requirement of your ranged weapons. In addition, Puncturing Shaft deals 20% more damage to targets within 8 yards.
assumptions: Ranger grill 2026-10-29 (#507). The old talent at its full rank (2). The client learns the dropped minimum range through spellmod1, the Twilight op MIN_RANGE (29, ADR 0010) at -100 on every shot; setting the Talent sends it and changing the row takes it away.

name: Twin Arrows
description: Instant cast. Low mana cost. Your primary mobile filler. Fires a quick physical arrow at the target. Has a 30% chance to fire a second, free Snapshot at the same target instantly.
assumptions: Ranger grill 2026-10-29 (#507). The old talent at its full rank (3). repeat_chance rolls once a cast whose strike landed; the repeat costs nothing, starts no cooldown and never repeats itself.

name: Rhythmic Draw
description: Instant cast. Low mana cost. Your primary mobile filler. Fires a quick physical arrow at the target. Each Snapshot cuts the cast time of your next Puncturing Shaft by 0.5 sec, stacking up to 15 times.
assumptions: Ranger grill 2026-10-29 (#507). The old talent at its full rank (5): each cast grants a stack of aura_rhythmic_draw_5, which the next Puncturing Shaft, or a Skill Choice of it, spends.

name: Adrenaline Rush
description: Instant cast. Low mana cost. Your primary mobile filler. Fires a quick physical arrow at the target. Its critical strikes take 6 sec off the cooldown of Vault.
assumptions: Ranger grill 2026-10-29 (#507). The old talent at its full rank (3), 2 s a rank. A crit cuts the cooldown of the version of Vault set on its row, never below 0. Ability_Hunter_SwiftStrike replaces the old icon, which was Cutthroat's Kick's.

name: Parting Gift
description: You instantly leap backward 15 yards to escape melee range and maintain your firing distance. Leaves a trap where you stood that roots the first enemy to step on it for 4 sec. The trap lasts 20 sec.
assumptions: Ranger grill 2026-10-29 (#507). The old talent at its full rank (2), 2 s a rank. The blink is queued, so the trap goes down at the spot the Ranger leaves; it arms at once, lasts 20 s, and is its own trap beside Snare Trap's.

name: Parting Shot
description: You instantly leap backward 15 yards to escape melee range and maintain your firing distance. On landing, fires a free Snapshot at your target.
assumptions: Ranger grill 2026-10-29 (#507). cast_skill casts the Ranger's current Snapshot (a Snapshot Skill Choice when one is set) at their target once the leap lands: free, off the global cooldown. With no living target in range and sight, nothing.

name: Unbound Leap
description: You instantly leap backward 15 yards to escape melee range and maintain your firing distance. The leap also removes movement slowing effects, and increases your run speed by 40% for 3 sec.
assumptions: Ranger grill 2026-10-29 (#507). shed_snares takes every snare off the Ranger with the stuns and roots Vault already sheds. The 40% run speed goes on the Ranger under this choice's spell id.

name: Jagged Barbs
description: Sinks a jagged arrow into the target, dealing physical damage over time and slowing their movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds. Each time it deals damage, it has a 20% chance to sunder the target's armor by 250 for 10 sec, stacking up to 3 times.
assumptions: Ranger grill 2026-10-29 (#507). The old talent at its full rank (5). The bleed keeps aura_barbed_arrow's spell id; each tick rolls 20% once to put aura_sundered_5 on the bleeding mob. Ability_PierceDamage replaces the old icon, which was Barbed Arrow's, and goes on Sundered too.

name: Pinning Barb
description: Sinks a jagged arrow into the target, dealing physical damage over time and slowing their movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds. Also roots the target for 2 sec.
assumptions: Ranger grill 2026-10-29 (#507). root under the stock Improved Wing Clip aura 19229 for 2 s. Roots take no diminishing returns in the realm.

name: Bloodscent
description: Sinks a jagged arrow into the target, dealing physical damage over time and slowing their movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds. Each time it deals damage, you regain 2% of your base mana.
assumptions: Ranger grill 2026-10-29 (#507). Each tick gives 2% of base mana once, logged under the bleed's spell id, as Rapid Fire's refund reads base mana.

name: Piercing Force
description: Your heavy artillery. Deals massive physical damage and naturally ignores a flat amount of the target's armor. It ignores 250 more armor, and its critical strikes deal 250% damage instead of 200%.
assumptions: Ranger grill 2026-10-29 (#507). The old talent at its full rank (5): 250 more armour ignored, and crit_damage_pct 25 multiplies the crit (200% x 1.25 = 250%).

name: Staggering Shaft
description: Your heavy artillery. Deals massive physical damage and naturally ignores a flat amount of the target's armor. Also stuns the target for 2 sec.
assumptions: Ranger grill 2026-10-29 (#507). stun under the stock Improved Concussive Shot aura 19410 for 2 s, with Bull Rush's diminishing returns.

name: Killshot
description: Your heavy artillery. Deals massive physical damage and naturally ignores a flat amount of the target's armor. Instant cast against a target below 30% health.
assumptions: Ranger grill 2026-10-29 (#507). below_instant reads the target's health as the cast starts: under 30% it has no cast bar.

name: Flurry
description: For 10 seconds, your ranged attack speed is increased by 40%, and your auto-shots refund a small amount of mana on hit. Your next 2 Snapshots after it cost no mana and are critical strikes.
assumptions: Ranger grill 2026-10-29 (#507). The old talent at its full rank (2): aura_flurry_2, two charges, spent by Snapshot or a Snapshot Skill Choice.

name: Rapid Assault
description: For 10 seconds, your ranged attack speed is increased by 40%, and your auto-shots refund a small amount of mana on hit. While it lasts, each Snapshot fires an extra free arrow for 50% weapon damage.
assumptions: Ranger grill 2026-10-29 (#507). The old active talent loses its 3 min button: aura_rapid_assault now lasts Rapid Fire's 10 s. Ability_UpgradeMoonGlaive replaces the old icon, which was Auto Shot's, and goes on the buff too.

name: Running Fire
description: For 10 seconds, your ranged attack speed is increased by 40%, and your auto-shots refund a small amount of mana on hit. While it lasts, Auto Shot keeps firing while you move.
assumptions: Ranger grill 2026-10-29 (#507). Grants aura_running_fire, Rapid Fire's buff under its own spell id with cast_while_moving on Auto Shot.

name: Parting Gift
description: Rooted. Cannot move.
assumptions: Ranger grill 2026-10-29 (#507). Parting Gift's root: aura_snare_trap's row under its own spell id, a root for 4 s; damage does not break it.

name: Rapid Fire
description: Ranged attack speed increased by 40%. Auto-shots refund mana. Auto Shot fires while moving.
assumptions: Ranger grill 2026-10-29 (#507). Running Fire's buff: aura_rapid_fire's row under its own spell id, name, visual and icon kept, with cast_while_moving on Auto Shot.

name: Acolyte
description: A dark mender who walks the line between life and death.
notes: Visual setup from the sheet: Naxxramas/Zul'Gurub assets (Void Zone or Death and Decay for Miasma, Bloodbolt for Blood Lance, Corruption or Consume Shadows for the buffs and heals).
assumptions: Tier 1, Tier Cap 30, form 0, mana, cloth (Davis 2026-10-18).

name: Creeping Blight
description: Infects the target with a Shadow DoT for 12 sec that grows: each tick adds a stack, and so does each Blood Lance that hits the target. Each tick deals its damage once per stack and heals you for 50% of it. Recasting it starts it over at one stack.
assumptions: Borrowed Shadow Word: Pain r1 (589).

name: Creeping Blight
description: Taking Shadow damage over time. It grows with every tick.
assumptions: Shadow Word: Pain r1 about 30% better a stack at level 10, 12 s in 3 s ticks (Davis 2026-10-25: was 18 s and 0.5/level; the nerf shortens the growth and front-loads the kit into Blood Lance; five-Calling sim at Power Level 10 in greens read 49.5 DPS before and 37.2 after, under the Cutthroat's 40.3). Goes on at 1 stack; each tick adds one after it deals damage; a recast starts it over at 1 stack with a fresh 12 s. No cap: 255 is the most the client shows (Davis 2026-10-23). Each tick heals the Acolyte half its damage, up to max health.

name: Blood Lance
